cohort: 625 term inborn neonates delivered at a hospital in Srikakulam, India over an 18-month period.
finding: Using a cord blood TSH cutoff value of >20 mU/L, no cases of congenital hypothyroidism were detected among the 625 newborns screened.
mod_finding: 65.8% of mothers underwent cesarean section and 34.2% had vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2.89kg, ranging from 2.5kg to 3.3kg.
